<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AuditNotification" name="Audit notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DocumentsSubmitted" name="Documents submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ClarificationRequest" name="Clarification request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Clarifications" name="Clarifications provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ReviewCompleted" name="Review completed without issues"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalReport" name="Final audit report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_AnnualAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Coordinator" name="Audit Coordinator" processRef="Process_Coordinator"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Regional" name="Regional Office" processRef="Process_Regional"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Compliance" name="Compliance Team" processRef="Process_Compliance"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Central" name="Central Audit Team" processRef="Process_Central"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_ExecBoard" name="Executive Board"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyRegional" name="Audit notification" sourceRef="SendTask_SendNotification" targetRef="StartEvent_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SubmitDocs" name="Submit documents" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="StartEvent_DocumentsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequestClarification" name="Request clarifications" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestClarification" targetRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendClarifications" name="Send clarifications" sourceRef="SendTask_SendClarifications" targetRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyReviewCompleted" name="Review completed" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyReviewCompleted" targetRef="CatchEvent_ReviewCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report" sourceRef="SendTask_DistributeReport" targetRef="Part_ExecBoard"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Audit Coordinator -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Coordinator" name="Audit Coordinator Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Initiate" name="Audit process initiated">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office" messageRef="Msg_AuditNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Notified" name="Notification sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Initiate" targetRef="SendTask_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendNotification" targetRef="EndEvent_Notified"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Regional Office -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Regional" name="Regional Office Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Notification" name="Audit notification received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Notification" messageRef="Msg_AuditNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Fork_Preparation" name="Split preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" name="Prepare financial statements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherDocuments" name="Gather necessary documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Preparation" name="Join preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team" messageRef="Msg_DocumentsSubmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_AwaitOutcome" name="Await review outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGateway_ReviewOutcome" name="Review outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ClarificationRequest" name="Clarification request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ClarRequest" messageRef="Msg_ClarificationRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide clarifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendClarifications" name="Send clarifications to central audit team" messageRef="Msg_Clarifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ReviewCompleted" name="Review completed without issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReviewCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ReviewCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RegionalDone" name="Regional office part completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Notification" targetRef="Fork_Preparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Fork_Preparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="Fork_Preparation" targetRef="Task_GatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R4" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" targetRef="Join_Preparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R5" sourceRef="Task_GatherDocuments" targetRef="Join_Preparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R6" sourceRef="Join_Preparation" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R7" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Merge_AwaitOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R8" sourceRef="Merge_AwaitOutcome" targetRef="EventGateway_ReviewOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R9" sourceRef="EventGateway_ReviewOutcome" targetRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10" sourceRef="EventGateway_ReviewOutcome" targetRef="CatchEvent_ReviewCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R11" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationRequest" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R12" sourceRef="SendTask_SendClarifications" targetRef="Merge_AwaitOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R13" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="SendTask_SendClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R14" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ReviewCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_RegionalDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Compliance Team -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Compliance" name="Compliance Team Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Compliance" name="Compliance check started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_K1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates affecting the audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_K1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_K2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ComplianceDone" name="Regulatory check completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_K2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Compliance" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="EndEvent_ComplianceDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Central Audit Team -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Central" name="Central Audit Team Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Central">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditTeam" name="Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DocumentsReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_RequestClarification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_ClarificationsReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyReviewCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Fork_RiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinancialRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OperationalRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ComplianceRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Join_RiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Investigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_RiskAddressed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_ReportReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DirectorReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DocumentsReceived" name="Documents submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DocumentsSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_DocumentsSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Review" name="Review entry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDocuments" name="Review submitted documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_T7">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestClarification" name="Request clarifications from regional office" messageRef="Msg_ClarificationRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ClarificationsReceived" name="Clarifications received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ClarificationsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Clarifications"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyReviewCompleted" name="Notify regional office that review is completed" messageRef="Msg_ReviewCompleted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Fork_RiskAssessment" name="Split risk assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinancialRisk" name="Evaluate financial risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OperationalRisk" name="Evaluate operational risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComplianceRisk" name="Evaluate compliance risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_RiskAssessment" name="Join risk assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_T18">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Investigation" name="Detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Investigation" name="Investigation launched">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I3</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitNeeded" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_I6">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I3</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I4</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I6</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I4</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I5</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Investigation" name="Investigation findings consolidated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I5</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I6</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I7</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Investigation" name="Investigation completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I7</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Investigation" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I2" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I3" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitNeeded"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitNeeded" targetRef="Task_SiteVisit">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I5" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisit" targetRef="Merge_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitNeeded" targetRef="Merge_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I7" sourceRef="Merge_Investigation" targetRef="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_RiskAddressed" name="All risks addressed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_ReportReview" name="Report ready for director review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DirectorReview" name="Review audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportApproval" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_T24">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T23</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report with required revisions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board" messageRef="Msg_FinalReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T27</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DocumentsReceived" targetRef="Merge_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T2" sourceRef="Merge_Review" targetRef="Task_ReviewDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T3" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationsReceived" targetRef="Merge_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="SendTask_RequestClarification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T6" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestClarification" targetRef="CatchEvent_ClarificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyReviewCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T8" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyReviewCompleted" targetRef="Fork_RiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T9" sourceRef="Fork_RiskAssessment" targetRef="Task_FinancialRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T10" sourceRef="Fork_RiskAssessment" targetRef="Task_OperationalRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T11" sourceRef="Fork_RiskAssessment" targetRef="Task_ComplianceRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T12" sourceRef="Task_FinancialRisk" targetRef="Join_RiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T13" sourceRef="Task_OperationalRisk" targetRef="Join_RiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T14" sourceRef="Task_ComplianceRisk" targetRef="Join_RiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T15" sourceRef="Join_RiskAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T16" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="SubProcess_Investigation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T17" sourceRef="SubProcess_Investigation" targetRef="Merge_RiskAddressed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T18" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Merge_RiskAddressed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T19" sourceRef="Merge_RiskAddressed" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T20" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Merge_ReportReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T21" sourceRef="Merge_ReportReview" targetRef="Task_DirectorReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T22" sourceRef="Task_DirectorReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReportApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T23" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="SendTask_DistributeReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T24" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T25" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Merge_ReportReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T26" sourceRef="SendTask_DistributeReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T27" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ExecutiveBoard_Unused" name="Unused" isExecutable="false"/>

</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T18" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitNeeded"/>

  </bpmn:process>
